text:
IncidentBot: :warning: High KV cache paging + batch admission anomalies detected on cluster inference-prod-us-2. Auto-escalation to #incidents. Please respond.

Priya Rao: ack. dashboards show a sudden rise in disk paging and a correlated spike in cont-batch "admission_retries" metric. p99 generation latency from 0.8s -> 4.5s. Seeing a few 5xxs.

Ethan Moore: I'm seeing a config rollout about 45m ago that increased MAX_BATCH_TOKENS to 24576 and MAX_NUM_SEQS to 32 for a perf experiment. That seems likely culprit.

Rachelle Torres: any customers impacted? CS reports two high-value accounts saw session lag and request timeouts.

Priya Rao: confirmed. Affected customers: nimbus-assist, helpdesk-ai. They had higher error rates and slow responses.

Ethan Moore: hypothesis: larger batch caps allowed controller to accumulate excessive KV entries per batch, KV cache grew beyond memory threshold, kernel started swapping. Also admission timeout was low which caused retries to pile up.

ops-bot: recent logs: "cont_batch: admitted seqs=28 tokens=23040"; kernel messages: "kswapd0 high","zone_reclaim failed".

Priya Rao: mitigation plan: immediate rollback of experiment config, and emergency admission cap enforcement. We'll also enable a conservative edge token-based throttle for long requests.

deploy-bot: queued emergency rollback job: job/rollback-contbatch-2535678901. Approve to execute?

Ethan Moore: approve. Rollback target values: MAX_BATCH_TOKENS=8192 MAX_NUM_SEQS=8 ADMISSION_TIMEOUT_MS=120000. Also set KV_CACHE_MAX_ENTRIES=180000 to encourage earlier evictions.

Priya Rao: executing canary rollback now. commands:
```bash
kubectl -n inference rollout pause deploy/cont-batch-controller
kubectl -n inference set env deploy/cont-batch-controller MAX_BATCH_TOKENS=8192 MAX_NUM_SEQS=8 ADMISSION_TIMEOUT_MS=120000
kubectl -n inference set env configmap/kv-cache-config MAX_ENTRIES=180000
kubectl -n inference rollout resume deploy/cont-batch-controller --selector=canary=true
```

Rachelle Torres: CS: notifying affected customers that we're investigating and applying a fix. Drafted message: "We're rolling a fix now to address incident impacting latency. We'll follow up with root cause and mitigation."

Priya Rao: canary signal looks good: p99 dropped to ~1.0s; paging IOPS down 75%; no new OOMs.

Ethan Moore: start a staged rollout: 15% -> 40% -> 70% -> 100% with 3m pauses. Keep edge throttle for >16k token hints.

ops-bot: rollout progress: 15% -> 40% (stable). Watchdog alerting on paging and 5xxs remains in passive mode.

Rachelle Torres: CS reports that customer errors are falling. Will open support tickets for the two customers and schedule follow-up.

Priya Rao: post-mitigation work: add atomic admission enforcement to cont-batch controller to prevent accepted_batch_tokens > configured MAX_BATCH_TOKENS. Also add a pre-deploy CI check to catch large config deltas for production clusters.

Ethan Moore: also propose: increase default ADMISSION_TIMEOUT_MS to 5000ms in prod if no SLA requires lower, to avoid retry storms. And add telemetry: record "effective_admitted_tokens" for every batch for alerting.

Priya Rao: action items assigned:
- (Ethan) implement atomic admission cap and telemetry + CI preflight (ETA: 3 days)
- (Priya) update runbook with edge-throttle play and staged rollout cadence (ETA: 24h)
- (Rachelle) coordinate customer follow-up and post-incident notes (ETA: 12h)
- (Ops) evaluate long-term KV cache tuning: per-tenant quotas, compressed values (ETA: 2 weeks)

deploy-bot: rollout complete: 100% (no rollback needed).

Priya Rao: marking incident severity reduced. Creating INC-253567 for full RCA and timeline. Handing off monitoring to Ethan for the next 8h.

Ethan Moore: ack. I'll monitor paging metrics and batch admission counts. Will post RCA to INC-253567 when ready. :white_check_mark:

IncidentBot: Incident state: mitigated. Log appended to incident timeline.
